create.name: Rika Marezawa
create.bio:
Rika Marezawa (希澤麗樺) is a Japanese animal communicator and teacher who leads the Pet and Human Happiness Laboratory, a general incorporated association known as Hapi-labo, from a salon in the Kamimaezu district of Nagoya. Born in Mie Prefecture in 1968, she lived in Australia after marrying and spent two decades as a full-time homemaker before a long and searching relationship with her own dog drew her into animal communication. She published two books on the bond between people and their pets under her former name, Riko Ohkochi, and changed her name in 2025. She is also a certified hypnotherapist, a member of the Japan Society of Hypnosis, and a certified Quantum-Touch Level 1 instructor.

Her central work is teaching people to sense what their animals are communicating, which she treats as a route back to their own intuition and life purpose. Courses run in small groups, in Nagoya and online, from a short taster through a six-month foundation course to advanced and professional training, with ongoing follow-up for graduates. She also teaches the two-day Quantum-Touch Level 1 workshop at the salon, gives individual sessions for people and their animals, has developed a self-enquiry practice she calls the Self Love Method, and sends a free group distance healing each month to animals whose owners subscribe to her newsletter.

courses.title: Nova animal communication course (新星アニマルコミュニケーション講座)
courses.description: A six-month course in animal communication that treats sensing an animal's inner voice as a natural intuitive skill anyone can recover. It includes a personal life-purpose session and unlimited messaging with Rika during the course; the basic option is online, the premium option is limited to six people at the salon or online.

courses.title: Individual sessions for people and animals
courses.description: One-to-one sessions in which she listens for the thoughts and messages of a client's animal, living or passed on, working from a photograph, and integrated sessions for people focused on life purpose. She chooses the approach to suit what the client brings.
courses.price: ￥55000 (Soul Pet therapy); ￥33000 (integrated session for people); ￥33000 (life-purpose discovery)

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Level 1 (クォンタムタッチ®Level.1)
courses.description: A two-day Quantum-Touch Level 1 workshop at her Nagoya salon, teaching the breath, intention and imagery techniques for sending life-force energy, in person or at a distance, with a particular eye to sharing it with animals. New dates are announced through her newsletter.
courses.price: ¥77,000 (税込, early booking); ¥88,000 (税込); ¥44,000 (税込, repeat or 18 and under)

free_resources.title: Free monthly group distance healing for pets
free_resources.description: On the 12th of each month at 8pm Japan time she sends ten minutes of distance healing to up to two hundred animals, including those that have passed on. It is open to newsletter subscribers, who sign up through a form sent before each session.
